PRINT AT 100% / ACTUAL SIZE
DISABLE FIT TO PAGE / shrink to fit / scale to fit. Measure the ruler before use: 0 to 100 must read 100.0 mm and the cross-check bar 50.0 mm (±0.5). If either is off, do not use the sheet: reprint.

Print every sheet from the PDF viewer at 100 % / Actual size, on A4 (T4 sheets are A4 landscape). Then lay a steel rule on the ruler below. Use the sheets only if 0 to 100 reads 100.0 mm and the bar reads 50.0 mm. A sheet that is 1 % small puts a hole 0.5 mm off at 50 mm.

SheetWhatUse
T1Locating ring P10 (+ optional ALEX foot P20)1:1 drilling
T2Feet plate P09, two pieces1:1 drilling
T3aOLOV plate P05 at 100: L2-L61:1 drilling
T3bOLOV plate P05 at 150: L11:1 drilling
T4-ARail A P06 station strip, 9 landscape sheets1:1 marking check
T4-BRail B P07 station strip, 9 landscape sheets1:1 marking check
T5Corner fitting P08 placementreference 1:2, not for drilling
T6Clamp pad plate P11 placementreference 1:4, positioning only

Using a drilling sheet: trim on the heavy datum line(s), butt the trimmed edge to the named edge, tape, then punch each DRILL centre through the paper with an awl or automatic centre punch, lift the sheet and drill to the depth stated. The printed jigs (P18) are the primary tools; these sheets reproduce their patterns and serve as the check. Top marking is done face down (underside up); every pattern here is used without flipping the sheet.
